name: EPIC 201693253
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 12.8 solar radii and 1.07 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201693253 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 12.782945 (16th-84th percentiles 12.205796-13.376391), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201693253 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.070893 (16th-84th percentiles 0.952212-1.20203), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201693253: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4596.766 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201693253 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3215.9375 (16th-84th percentiles 3102.1875-3332.109375), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.17 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,216 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 1.07 solar masses and 12.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,597 K at its surface.
